original_ai_output.title_zh: 卡杜纳警方击退疑似盗牛者并追回39头被盗牛
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚卡杜纳州警方称，在伊加比地方政府区伊拉村击退一起疑似盗牛者袭击，追回39头被盗牛。据警方发言人声明，11月7日凌晨武装人员袭击村庄，盗走三名富拉尼牧民的牛，并开枪打伤一名25岁男子双腿。目前该事件为单一来源报道，细节尚待进一步核实。

location.site: 伊拉村（伊加比地方政府区）
location.raw_text: Illa Village, Igabi Local Government Area, Kaduna State

key_facts.fact: 卡杜纳州警方称击退疑似盗牛者袭击并追回39头被盗牛
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Police Command in Kaduna State has repelled an attack by suspected cattle rustlers and recovered 39 stolen cows in Illa Village, Igabi Local Government Area.

key_facts.fact: 袭击发生在11月7日凌晨约4时，武装人员盗走三名富拉尼牧民的牛
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: at about 4:00 am the same day, a group of armed men attacked the village, rustled cows belonging to three Fulani herders

key_facts.fact: 一名25岁男子阿布巴卡尔双腿中枪受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: shot one Abubakar, 25, in both legs

key_facts.fact: 警方发言人DSP Mansir Hassan于周日发表声明披露此事
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Police Public Relations Officer, DSP Mansir Hassan, disclosed this in a statement released on Sunday in Kaduna.

uncertainties: 袭击者身份仅为疑似盗牛者，尚未确认
事件目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，缺乏交叉验证
伤者伤情及后续情况未获进一步确认
